horoscopes.horoscope: Positive thinking can change the world, and you could do with some today. No matter how tough the going gets, take it in your stride, says Ganesha. If you think you can do it, you will. You have the magic touch today to initiate a new business strategy. You will remain safer if you avoid getting into unnecessary arguments with your beloved without thinking pros and cons. Being impatient may put you in trouble, feels Ganesha. You need to be careful of your words, advises Ganesha. Sharing your dreams with your sweetheart would be a good idea. Spend time in thinking more seriously about things which you wish to initiate. As you will be full of energy, you can also join gym and continue it till it becomes a habit. Help others but not to the extent of draining yourself. If you give your impulsive desire to spend free rein, you may end up overspending on things that may not be very essential. You will need to stay focused on your primary requirement. This is a terrific day to launch a new venture. Brimming with dedication, you are in a mood to pour your utmost concentration and will accomplish tasks efficiently. However, you need to avoid being too fast and furious. Save your precious energies for future use, suggest Ganesha.

Definitely not a day when you plan to get your feet dirty (maybe a pedicure, though). You might delay the start of a new project. Perhaps, a romantic escape with your sweetheart or a day in the spa grooming yourself with a lavish makeover will validate your lethargy today. Either way, it will be heavy on your pocket. It’s safe to be diplomatic in matters of the heart, reminds Ganesha. You need to be cautious and careful of your words if you want to enjoy happiness in perpetuity. Love life will be good once you will be able to relate to your sweetheart. Maintaning mental balance is very important today. This will adress your mood swings. You can also get rid of your bad habits by taking firm decisions. The day is also good to invest time in Yoga or any other spiritual practice. You will not be rash at all with your financial decisions. Unexpected expenses are most likely. You should avoid lending money to others today, as chances of easy recovery are very less. The daily routine will keep you busy. You need to take an important decision regarding a major project. People around you are dependant on you. So make sure that you will understand the matter thoroughly before coming to conclusion. Say the right word at the right time, suggest Ganesha.

Ganesha advices that while today will be a day filled with a lot of festivity, you still need to guard against getting carried away. You will spend the day socialising with friends and family. You might end up neglecting your household duties in organizing some function or picnic, says Ganesha. You will be in a mood to spice up your romance. You may invite your special somone over for a wonderful dinner and wish to encourage a frivolous chatting session. Sparks flying between you and your sweetheart will sweeten your relationship on the romantic front, feels Ganesha. Like a wanderer, you will feel like going places to seek more information. There shall be an intense desire to contact your friends, relatives and associates. You may expend most of the day to maintain relationships. Make sure you attend your work, too. You may spend your money today indulging in the creature comforts that you can afford to buy. You should avoid investing your money in the stock markets, or you may make some erroneous moves. With things going awesome, you will feel great today. There will be no issues as you strictly adhere to routines. You seem to be sensible whenever it comes to responsibilities. The applause you will receive from bosses for the tasks done shall make you feel proud.

A hectic day, combined with domestic pressure will make you exhausted. You feel a heavy burden on mind and heart. Don’t be too emotional, says Ganesha. Take care not to pass domestic burdens on to your career or business, and thereby mar your capacity and efficiency. Things may not go right in your relationship, foresees Ganesha. Differences in opinions or mindsets may broaden the communication gap. Therefore, you need to stay cautious and avoid getting into unnecessary arguments with your partner. Otherwise, you may lose trust and respect, fears Ganesha. Feeling zippy, you will plan a hike or go on a picnic with your near and dear ones. Spend this beautiful day outdoors to enjoy the natural landscapes and breathe some fresh air. Be optimistic and control your anger for better health. Today is an auspicious day for investment of energy but not in tangible things. Try to remain associated with people in powerful positions as they are likely to fetch you good deals. Good news is on the cards. You will receive applause for your efforts, foresees Ganesha. This will make you more than happy. You will feel great thinking that your colleagues depend on you. You will love to take more responsibilities, says Ganesha.

You will pay more attention to the younger members in the family. You will guide the children in improving their daily schedule. An occasion to celebrate will present itself. You will be desirous of participating in some competition or program, says Ganesha. You will feel born romantic with your sweetheart, foresees Ganesha. Melodies from classic movies will make you nostalgic tonight, feels Ganesha. You are in a mood to play a short drama with your soul mate. Movie. music, dance, drama are likely to reign your heart this beautiful evening. If you get angry, you may drain your energy uselessly. Rather you should ensure your time and energy is used in the right type of tasks. Your health will be very good and if you don’t want to get tired, stay positive about things. The day indicates that you will be able to maintain your life-style with the help of money and there won’t be any compromise in the same. At the same time, your drive to earn more money may be active. You will turn creative in your work, foresees Ganesha. Your ideas will be used to fetch positive business results. You need to focus more on innovation in order to encourage creativity from your teammates. You are sure to receive appreciation from your superiors.

Foreign contacts will in all likelihood be a source of monetary profits. Ganesha says you will perform wonderfully in anything you might choose to undertake today. Even your ambition of setting up an offshore business enterprise will take root today. You may try your best to draw the attention of your beloved today. You may feel that nobody knows your soulmate better than you and thus like to tease or appreciate him/her in order to build a sweet relationship. A good relationship is on the cards, foresees Ganesha. Socialising is on the cards for you today. Some associates are likely to visit your office, or few guests may drop into your home. After a tiring day, listen to soft music or spiritual songs to soothe your tired mind and body. It may be frustrating for you to note that your efforts to earn more money are proving to be futile. However, Ganesha feels that this is a passing phase, and things will soon be okay. You are likely to set your own standard and deadline, foresees Ganesha. You may make a new routine and take responsibilities to finish it on time. You will be pushed to get rid of pending tasks by burying yourself behind your laptop the whole day.

Lady Luck smiles on you today. With all the good fortune on your side, it’s assured to be a day when financial gains come your way, especially if you are in the banking business. Agreed everything is going your way today, but be careful not to let your emotions cloud your reasoning and slow you down. Don your rational hat and lower your expectations a little. It never hurts to want less, especially since it is saves you from disappointments later on, advises Ganesha. Shopping with your darling may sound costly to you but both of you will surely be having a lovely evening in a peaceful place. It’s the ideal time to get closer to your soulmate and make his/her dream come true. After all, make your sweetheart feel how special you are. Your day will be full of social interactions and communication with people. As this will consume lot of energy, so you can get stressed. To check this stress, you should do those activities which you like. You can also try Yoga or other spiritual practices. You may spend money on pleasing your life-partner or someone who has been with you for a long time. Ganesha feels that you may spend money to maintain your public image. Today, you will enjoy the mixed benefit of work plus pleasure, foresees Ganesha. However, with an increase in responsibilities, you must not expect a rise in pay scale. Rechecking the current working status will help you develop a systematic routine, suggest Ganesha.

Ganesha asks you to practice caution today. There are strong possibilities that an evil eye may attack you in some or other way. So, keep a watchful eye. And remember, every day brings along an experience and a lesson with it. Learn and move on. Ganesha feels that you need to avoid being critical of your lover’s activities. Adjustment is the keyword to maintaining a long-term relationship, believes Ganesha. You need to take care of your lover’s interest and prestige. Remember, your partner needs the utmost attention. You may not be happy with the outcomes of your tasks which is likely to make you a bit frustrated. If you get frustrated, your energy level will drop. Don’t let that happen. Maintain positive outlook and ignore things that are disappointing. Ganesha feels that you should try to maintain good rapport with those who owe you money. This will help make recovery of money easy. Money may be spent on recurring daily expenses. You seem to go slow than usual and you may not feel motivated to earn extra money, foresees Ganesha. You tend to be logically sound but Ganesha feels you need to put more efforts in your tasks. It will eventually help you achieve your daily goals and maintain productivity.

Your stars are aligned in a way that you may have to travel long distance, either for business or for leisure. Socially, you are active as you are likely to attend a function and take the centre stage. You may also participate in religious activities and give importance of rites and rituals, if need be, informs Ganesha. Today is the right time to go out with your sweetheart and spend the time peacefully in the garden. Your partner is ready to give you emotional support. Chilling out with your sweetheart and basking in romantic bliss is on the cards, foresees Ganesha. This fantastic day will be filled to the brim with positivity and exuberance. Ideally, you should utilise your energy in outdoor activities. Also, do some heavy workouts to burn the extra calories and shape your muscles. Have a sumptuous meal, too! You will have a strong desire to go on leisure trip, but you must also remain practical while planning it, else you may end up spending more money that can be justified. The amazing creative energy you possess today will urge you to hone your professional skills. Your enthusiasm to shoulder more will only increase pressure at work. It would be better if you rework on your potential, feels Ganesha. You may not want to lament later if things are not all right.

After all the drudgery you endured in a bid to reach a certain point in your career, it’s time to sit back and enjoy the rewards, says Ganesha. Today, you can expect to get a transfer, a promotion, a pay hike or all the three. But these will be accompanied by added responsibilities and work, leaving you wondering if it really was an achievement or a bait used to trap you. A lucrative job offer may also come your way, and given the circumstances, you may find it hard to resist. Nothing special is foreseen in the love front. However, Ganesha feels that you are likely to remain satisfied with the way your relationship is going currently. A homely affair is on the cards, foresees Ganesha. You will feel relaxed with your loved one. Ganesha observes that you may begin the day feeling a bit on the lethargic side, and make excuses for shirking work. Avoid taxing your brain and don’t overburden yourself. Right time to review your strategies. Take good care of your health. This is a good day to start your research on how to fulfill your desire to purchase a new vehicle or a new house. You will be able to direct your thinking properly to purchase long term assets. With things moving at a normal pace, your day shall be free of hassles. You may want to arrange the things in order and may call for a meeting or discussion. Setting rules for yourself and others at the workplace will fill you with a sense of discipline.

You will tackle complicated issues with infinite ease! But you will also find people passing the buck onto you. It irks you no end, having to take the blame for others’ mistakes. But here’s a chance, says Ganesha, to turn a weakness into a strength. Taking your lover for granted is just not the right way to go about things. You need to speak and express yourself, advises Ganesha. You want to think differently and take the time to be comfortable. You may be waiting for the best person and Ganesha feels that you will get the opportunity today. With your mind power rising today, you should make the most of your abilities to solve complex issues. Stay active and you shall be amazed at what it can do for your mood and outlook. Your resistance power will skyrocket, too! Ganesha feels that the chances of money getting spent on short-distance trips are high. You may not be in a very enviable position on the financial front, so think of how to increase inflows. This is a good day to focus on conversations. Meet up with service providers as your stars support important communications today. If you are not happy with anything, this is the right time to discuss, clarify your doubt and solve the issue, suggests Ganesha.

The focus today will be on self-improvement. You may find yourself attending seminars or workshops. Self-employed people are likely to find lucrative deals landing in their laps in the afternoon. Quality time with your family in the evening will give you a sense of balance and of belonging, says Ganesha. You might want to relax in the arms of your beloved. You will feel great about the changes you have already made in your relationship. Ganesha feels that you will like to relax and walk with your sweetheart holding his/her hands. On the health front, the cosmos may not be in your favour. Workload may be heavy and cause anxiety. Put in all your efforts to complete the tasks within the predetermined time-limits. Don’t get upset – you have tried your best. Today is a good day to take advise of your chartered accountant, if you wish to sort out your financial tangles. Think positively about long term financial planning and execution. While you seem emotionally attached to your work, you will have a good time throughout the day. The pace of the work will remain good. You can confidently progress at the workplace plus you may spend the time having fun with your colleagues.
